description: Save a short part of a video as an animated GIF (default) or WebP to a folder on this machine. from and to are seconds or m:ss (default 5 s from from); fps default 10 and width default 480, both capped by the server limits (VID2CONTEXT_MAX_CLIP_*). For a video clip with sound use download_media with from and to. Download only media you have the rights to: your own uploads, public-domain or Creative Commons works, or videos the site lets you download.

dir.description: Folder to save to: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the default folder

from.description: Start: seconds, m:ss or h:mm:ss. Default 0

url.description: Video URL, YouTube id or local file path

name: export_clip
title: Export an animated GIF or WebP
